description: Full record of one firm: investor category, overview, inclusion evidence, the category's module columns (FoF strategies, PPC type, RIA segments, CRD…), decision-makers with contacts (under the contacts-restricted rule), website, philanthropy, news, past and upcoming events, sources and data date. Each firm whose full record is returned counts once per seat per calendar month toward the allowance of 500 firms a month (opening it again this month is free); past the allowance the firm's teaser is returned instead.
name: get_investor
title: Open an investor
